title: Coherence laws for normalized open restriction data
statement: Normalized open comparisons satisfy the derived coefficient-composition cocycle and identity-unit equations.

proof.text: The comparison words agree on every summand; sheafification uniqueness and exact localization preserve the equations.

lean.statement: theorem systemOpenRestrictionLaws (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] (c : RestrictionIdentifications.{u} l) (g : ∀ (B C : Etale.SystemProjection.Coefficients.{u} l) (a : B.rings ⟶ C.rings), GeometricSquare a j) (o : ∀ (B C : Etale.SystemProjection.Coefficients.{u} l) (a : B.rings ⟶ C.rings), OpenComparison (g B C a)) : (∀ (B C D : Etale.SystemProjection.Coefficients.{u} l) (a : B.rings ⟶ C.rings) (b : C.rings ⟶ D.rings) (L : VaryingRing.Derived (levels D) (steps D) X), (VaryingRing.J (levels B) (steps B) j).map ((c.rho X a b).hom.app L) ≫ (o B D (a ≫ b)).derived.hom.app L = (o B C a).derived.hom.app ((derivedRestriction X b).obj L) ≫ (derivedRestriction Z a).map ((o C D b).derived.hom.app L) ≫ (c.rho Z a b).hom.app ((VaryingRing.J (levels D) (steps D) j).obj L)) ∧ (∀ (B : Etale.SystemProjection.Coefficients.{u} l) (L : VaryingRing.Derived (levels B) (steps B) X), (o B B (𝟙 B.rings)).derived.hom.app L ≫ (c.derivedUnit Z B).hom.app ((VaryingRing.J (levels B) (steps B) j).obj L) = (VaryingRing.J (levels B) (steps B) j).map ((c.derivedUnit X B).hom.app L))
